ENGLISH LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 1.4.1 Functional Writing: Filling Forms, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.4.1 Functional Writing: Filling Forms.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.4.1 Functional Writing: Filling Forms.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.4.1 Functional Writing: Filling Forms.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.4.1 Functional Writing: Filling Forms.

2. When practising Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns.

3. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Only one word repeated
   B. Many unrelated topics with no link
   C. No full stops
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences

4. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. going
   B. goed
   C. went
   D. goes

5. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. where is the library
   B. Where is the Library
   C. Where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking Listening Comprehension.

10. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. run
   B. quickly
   C. blue
   D. happiness

11. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Only an action
   C. A person, place, thing, or idea
   D. Only a describing word

----
